# FFmpeg 7.1 for Azahar UWP

The DLLs in `bin/` are a native x64 Microsoft AppContainer build of upstream
FFmpeg tag `n7.1.2`, commit `f893221c8d89cb798b829bebe71d55e1a3f242fd`.
They are not desktop/MinGW DLLs.

The build uses the LGPL configuration below. It intentionally contains only
the muxers, encoders, filters, and protocols needed by Azahar's local video
dumper and UDP MPEG-TS streaming, keeping the Xbox package and runtime
scanning cost small.

```text
--toolchain=msvc
--arch=x86_64
--target-os=win32
--enable-cross-compile
--enable-shared
--disable-static
--disable-programs
--disable-doc
--disable-debug
--disable-avdevice
--enable-network
--disable-decoders
--disable-demuxers
--disable-parsers
--disable-bsfs
--disable-hwaccels
--disable-protocols
--enable-protocol=file,udp
--disable-muxers
--enable-muxer=mp4,matroska,avi,mpegts
--disable-encoders
--enable-encoder=h264_mf,mpeg4,rawvideo,ffv1,aac,flac,pcm_s16le
--disable-filters
--enable-filter=buffer,buffersink,fps,format,scale
--disable-dxva2
--disable-d3d11va
--disable-d3d12va
--disable-vulkan
--disable-gpl
--disable-version3
--extra-cflags=-MD -DWINAPI_FAMILY=WINAPI_FAMILY_APP -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00
--extra-ldflags=-APPCONTAINER WindowsApp.lib
```

Before compilation, `dist/uwp/ffmpeg-winrt.patch` makes FFmpeg's CPU-count
selection prefer its existing WinRT implementation over
`GetProcessAffinityMask`. The latter introduces
`api-ms-win-core-processtopology-obsolete-l1-1-0.dll`, which is unavailable on
Xbox and prevents `avutil-59.dll` from loading. `dist/uwp/ffmpeg-uwp-mf-encoder.patch`
lets `h264_mf` with `hw_encoding=1` drive the console's hardware transform: it
hands the transform a D3D11 device manager, polls its asynchronous events
without blocking, describes the input type explicitly and pads input samples
to the size the transform reports. The build script applies both overlays to
the pinned source only for the build and restores the checkout afterward. The MSVC Store import-library directory is also placed first while
linking so the runtime depends on `VCRUNTIME140_APP.dll` supplied by the Xbox
VCLibs framework, never the unavailable desktop `VCRUNTIME140.dll`.

Dependency resolution also enables the MOV muxer, H.263 encoder, AC-3 parser,
and a small set of required bitstream filters. The user interface enumerates
what these libraries actually support instead of advertising unavailable
desktop encoders such as `libx264` or `libvpx-vp9`.

The shipped binaries were produced with Visual Studio 2022 MSVC 14.44.35207,
Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0, NASM 2.16.01, and `--disable-debug`. Every DLL is
x64, has the PE App Container flag, and imports only OneCore/UWP-compatible
system libraries plus the other FFmpeg DLLs.

SHA-256:

```text
8DA2AA812339F963EE1B4E7283784DC1AACD16303396313919439342B833E8BB  avcodec-61.dll
D8DEABC276F94C000CAD5F41E213E3DF624EFDFFE58E6A0BBB8F94022AF70D22  avfilter-10.dll
94C88AB0051CB7CAE73466BBAC419CF75C9815B0E05502C23B02243A34F3DF44  avformat-61.dll
E18A3A4B7A0EA285F5513EA8B57285FDC84A8E2D500720B2676C292863D85AD0  avutil-59.dll
62C428DCFCCC1F6591A5225B39EB3BEAC814AE91ABB87C64F6DC5FAEAAFA0466  swresample-5.dll
CA5CD3C15BEB1AAADC64307428353C17C13FDAAAA1EB92C269D6AA746B505F99  swscale-8.dll
```

`include/` and the import libraries in `lib/` come from the same build; Azahar
links them directly.

Run `dist/uwp/build_ffmpeg.ps1` from PowerShell to rebuild and restage the
runtime. FFmpeg is licensed under LGPL 2.1 or later; see `LICENSE.txt`.
